arabic text: Beta tujhe mein lori sunaaungi saari raat
english translation text: My son, I will sing you lullabies throughout the night

arabic text: Aaja ke bar raha hai, andhera ay mere laal\nKhud aake dekhle tu, huwa kya hai mera haal\nSowungi saath tujhko sulaaungi saari raat
english translation text: Come, darkness is spreading, O my beloved\nCome yourself and see what has become of your mother\nI will sleep beside you and put you to sleep throughout the night

arabic text: Taqdeer ka ye kaisa, mera imtehaan hai\nKisko bataoon mushkil mein, ab meri jaan hai\nIs bebasi ke aansoon bahaaungi saari raat
english translation text: What kind of trial of destiny is this for me?\nTo whom can I tell that my life is now in danger?\nI will shed these tears of helplessness throughout the night

arabic text: Awaaz de rahi hai, sakina kahan ho tum\nMaa aur beheno par, khuda ra karo rehm\nKaise bina tumhaare bithaaungi saari raat
english translation text: Sakina calls out: where are you?\nFor God's sake, have mercy upon your mother and sisters\nHow will I sit without you throughout the night?

arabic text: Bethi hai paas jhule ke, itna hi soch ke\nMaa ki sadaa wo sunke to, aayega lawt ke\nGodi mein tujhko apni bithaaungi saari raat
english translation text: She sits beside the cradle, thinking only this:\nPerhaps he will hear his mother's voice and return\nI will seat you in my lap throughout the night

arabic text: Aankhon mein leke bethi hoon, jhule ke doriyaan\nDede ke thak gayi hoon, khayalon mein loriyaan\nUmmeed ke liye mein jalaaongi saari raat
english translation text: I sit holding the cradle's cords before my eyes\nExhausted from singing lullabies only in my imagination\nI will keep the lamp of hope burning throughout the night
